summary: A Yes vote raises the allowed height for multi-family residential development in the R-4 zone from three stories and 35 feet to four stories and 42 feet.

housing.text: A Yes vote increases the R-4 multi-family height limit from three stories to four.
housing.quote: Measure D is another example of the tension between state requirements and local control. It asks voters whether to increase the R-4 multi-family height limit from three stories to four; I do not support that increase.

housing.text: A No vote keeps the R-4 multi-family height limit at three stories.
housing.quote: Measure D is another example of the tension between state requirements and local control. It asks voters whether to increase the R-4 multi-family height limit from three stories to four; I do not support that increase.
